defect.reproducer: Remove only the publish_hz bound from the validator; start patrol, set 5.0 then 0.0. Patrol exits with ZeroDivisionError at 1.0 / publish_hz. Real commands and traceback are in broken-commands.md and broken-commands-patrol.txt; identical failing regression in regression-before.txt.
defect.root_cause: Missing validation allows zero to be committed in ROS. The post-set callback divides by zero while computing the timer period, terminating the process before the service replies.
defect.proof_after: lab_4 validates finite publish_hz in [1, 30] before applying values. Zero is rejected, get still returns 5.0, and measured stream stays about 5 Hz. The same regression passes and proves the old timer, active fields and stored parameter are preserved. See fixed-commands.md and regression-after.txt.
